reviews.body:
### 🟡 Changes recommended The CSV change lacks the required mocked-provider Robot regression verifying that the CLI retains the header and completed rows after a stream failure while still reporting the error.
1 open issue - [Add regression test for partial CSV output on stream failure](https://github.com/stackql/stackql/pull/905#discussion_r4517605442) · New
What changed in this PR This PR preserves buffered CSV rows when a result stream fails, aligning CSV output with the table writer’s partial-output behavior. **Changes:** - Flushes an initialized CSV writer before returning the stream error. - Adds a unit regression test checking that the header and completed row survive while the original error is returned. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `internal/​stackql/​output/​partial_table_test.go` | Adds CSV partial-output regression coverage. | | `internal/​stackql/​output/​output.go` | Flushes buffered CSV output on stream failure. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: Please add a mocked-provider Robot regression for this user-visible CSV change, as required by the repository's testing guidelines. Run a CSV query that emits a completed batch before the stream fails, then assert through the CLI that the header and completed rows are retained and the failure is still reported.
